verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TUZZE gy'oli,Ayi Katonda,
Katonda ow'okwagala;
Nga tubasabira bano
Obagatte wamu.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Bwe baba nga basanyuka
Olugendo nga lulungi,
Bakwesigenga ggwe wekka,
Mu ggwe babenga-omu.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ne mu biro eb'ennaku,
Omuyaga bga gukunta;
Era bakwesigenga ggwe,
Obeerenga nabo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Byonna ebiribajjira
Oba ssanyu oba nnaku,
Obawenga ekisa kyo
Obeerenga nabo.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Mu ndwadde ne mu bulamu,
Mu bwavu ne mu bugagga;
Okwagala kwo okungi
Kubeetooloolenga.
